fact_text: Fundamental analysis reads a company's financial statements alongside government policy, industry data and economic factors before forming an investment view.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Listed companies publish financial reports every quarter, and the annual report covers the full fiscal year, giving investors a regular view of business performance.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Pakistan's fiscal year runs from 1 July to 30 June, while banks typically report on a calendar year running from 1 January to 31 December.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Government can levy taxes both on a company's production and on its sales, and each tax reduces revenue and profit, so an analyst maps them for each company.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: An analyst checks each sector's import and export restrictions, because most taxes fall on imports and a new limit can cut a company's profit in a later fiscal year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: A government subsidy paid to the producer can lower the consumer price, and the lower price can raise the producer's turnover as demand grows.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Solar panel makers would see turnover rise sharply if government subsidies push consumers to install panels, so an analyst checks subsidy announcements for affected sectors.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Under price control the regulator can set a ceiling or a floor on a medicine's price, so a drugmaker cannot sell above the cap even when demand is strong.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The drug regulator sets consumer prices for essential medicines such as paracetamol and Panadol, which limits how much those products can earn per unit.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Pharmaceutical makers buy their active ingredient raw material mostly from India, so import duties and trade policy directly affect their input costs.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: An analyst checks whether government has added import duties or import limits for a carmaker such as Toyota, since a new levy can lower the company's profit in a later year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Market share is the portion of buyers in a market who choose a given company's product, and a high share signals pricing power and wide reach.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The analyst names fertilizer market share as the key check, questioning why Engro Fertilizers' share is falling and comparing it with FFC and Fatima.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: A margin is the gap between sales and cost: a firm selling 100 at a cost of 60 keeps 40, while a peer whose cost is 90 keeps only 10, signalling weaker efficiency.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Analysts compare peers on the same sales base, such as cost and margin per 1,000 of sales, to see which company turns sales into profit more efficiently.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: A policy rate cut from 20% to 15% lowers interest on a borrower's debt, so a company with a 1 lakh loan saves about 5,000 a year; the effect matters most for heavily indebted firms.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Fiscal policy shows where government spends, such as infrastructure, and an analyst maps which listed companies supply those projects when a budget announces them.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: Cement and steel makers gain from a city's infrastructure spending only if their product is sold in that city, such as Karachi, not merely because the plant is elsewhere.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: A financial model combines company reports, policy rates and sector data to estimate where a company will stand in two to four years, which supports the investment decision.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The analyst lists negative triggers that call for reassessing a holding: a super tax, an export ban, ended subsidies, price control, falling market share, high debt, a higher policy rate and thinner margins.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The analyst lists positive triggers that can lift a company's profit: import concessions, subsidies, tax cuts, and the removal of price control, which lets a firm raise its prices.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)

fact_text: The Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan regulates more than 500 companies, a number the government is gradually reducing.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'The Valuation Mastery | Class 02 | The Step-by-Step Fundamental Analysis Blueprint | Afaque Manzar' (YouTube, 2025-10-10)
